description: Source code for managing MCUmgr groups, handlers, callbacks, and initialization in Zephyr OS.

methods.name: mgmt_unregister_group
methods.description: Unregisters a management group from the global list.

methods.name: mgmt_find_handler
methods.description: Finds a handler for a given group and command ID.

methods.name: mgmt_find_group
methods.description: Finds a management group by its ID.

methods.name: mgmt_get_handler
methods.description: Retrieves a handler for a specific group and command ID if valid.

methods.name: mgmt_find_error_translation_function
methods.description: Finds the error translation function for a specific group ID (SMP support).

methods.name: mgmt_callback_register
methods.description: Registers a callback for management events.

methods.name: mgmt_callback_unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a callback for management events.

methods.name: mgmt_callback_notify
methods.description: Notifies registered callbacks of an event, handling errors and aborts.

methods.name: mgmt_evt_get_index
methods.description: Gets the index of an event based on its bitmask.

methods.name: mcumgr_handlers_init
methods.description: Initializes all registered MCUmgr handlers at startup.
